lines.text: Antigravity in SpecWithCode: plan, build, review.
lines.spoken: Antigravity in Spec With Code: plan, build, review.

lines.text: In your repo, run specweave init with the Antigravity adapter. It adds AGENTS.md and eleven SpecWeave skills.
lines.spoken: In your repo, run spec weave init with the Antigravity adapter. It adds agents dot M D and eleven spec weave skills.

lines.text: Open SpecWithCode, then Settings, Providers. Click Add provider and pick Antigravity. SpecWithCode installs its own Antigravity agent. Click Sign in and finish with your Google account in the browser. This one is already signed in.
lines.spoken: Open Spec With Code, then Settings, Providers. Click Add provider and pick Antigravity. Spec With Code installs its own Antigravity agent. Click Sign in and finish with your Google account in the browser. This one is already signed in.

lines.text: Add the repo: the plus next to Projects, Local folder, then its path. A new chat opens. Pick Gemini 3.8 Flash under Antigravity, and set Full access for this demo.
lines.spoken: Add the repo: the plus next to Projects, Local folder, then its path. A new chat opens. Pick Gemini three point eight Flash under Antigravity, and set Full access for this demo.

lines.text: Type a dollar sign, pick sw-increment, and describe the change. Antigravity writes spec.md: acceptance criteria and a task with its files and test.
lines.spoken: Type a dollar sign, pick S W increment, and describe the change. Antigravity writes spec dot M D: acceptance criteria, and a task with its files and test.

lines.text: Then send sw-do. Antigravity claims the task, changes the code, and runs the test. The task is marked done only when the test passes.
lines.spoken: Then send S W do. Antigravity claims the task, changes the code, and runs the test. The task is marked done only when the test passes.

lines.text: Click Open diff to review the code, the test, and the ledger line that records who finished the task.
lines.spoken: Click Open diff to review the code, the test, and the ledger line that records who finished the task.

lines.text: Next, sw-done verifies and closes the increment.
lines.spoken: Next, S W done verifies and closes the increment.
